steps.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. NEW SCENE COMPOSITION, landscape 16:9 cute strong pixel-art Chinese high school classroom. The reference is ONLY a small-character palette/style guide. Draw a BRAND-NEW CAMERA position: SIDE VIEW at seated eye height from the central aisle looking sideways at the window wall. This MUST look entirely different from the previous rear-facing classroom images. Main subject: a complete RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE of the original chibi brown-haired boy, green vest/white shirt/red tie/navy trousers/brown shoes, quietly reading. He occupies foreground center-left. His body faces RIGHT toward the classroom FRONT. His desk is in FRONT OF HIM ON THE RIGHT. His chair is BEHIND HIM ON THE LEFT. Draw the entire unambiguous arrangement and the whole body from head to both shoes. His wooden blue-metal chair back is at x about 24% of image width, his back/hips at about 33%, his bent knees at about 43%, and front edge of his single desk at about 60%. His hips SIT ON the chair seat, which visibly supports them; thighs go HORIZONTALLY FORWARD TO THE RIGHT under the desk, knees bend DOWN, lower legs end at feet resting on the floor under the desk. Do NOT face him toward the viewer or toward the left. His forearms rest on the desk TO HIS RIGHT. The whole seated body is structurally correct and chair seat, thigh, knees, both feet can be inspected. There is no desk behind him, no table crossing his back, no empty chair in front of him. This is a true side-on furniture/pose relationship.
His navy-haired deskmate sits in the adjacent seat farther from camera, also facing RIGHT, on his own matching chair behind his own desk. Their TWO identical individual desks join side by side across the room depth, sharing a visible center seam; desk tops and chair sizes match perspective. Their classmates in the middle distance have the same RIGHT-FACING seating orientation, reading or subtly talking in pairs. Several further rows, about 20 small classmates across the background, naturally grounded. Camera is INSIDE the classroom and horizontal sliding windows run along the BACKGROUND WALL BEHIND the two boys, with normal sill and wall below, rectangular frames, left-right tracks, wet trees outside. The classroom front wall and green blackboard are visible only at the FAR RIGHT EDGE in perspective, with a one-step raised wooden platform and teacher desk on that right/front wall; NO teacher. A crowded narrow Chinese classroom, no fantasy castle. Warm wooden paired desks, blue metal legs/chairs, green uniforms, pale wall, mint/blue window trim. Deliberate large square pixel clusters and crisp restrained 16-bit handheld-RPG sprite rendering, limited earthy palette, cute chibi proportions. Not a smooth illustration and not photorealistic. Plain unannotated finished cinematic scene, no words, no logos, no labels, no subtitle panel. Foreground floor shows clear shadows beneath all four chair/desk legs and both shoes, with enough room to read the support. Main priority is EXACT RIGHT-FACING SEATED SIDE PROFILE and furniture on the correct sides; secondary priority is cute detailed matching handheld pixel style.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this newly drawn pixel-art side-view Chinese classroom. Preserve the excellent RIGHT-FACING SEATED SIDE PROFILE, the two boys, all their clothing, both chairs, the paired desk, the visible supported hips, bent knees, and grounded feet EXACTLY. Do NOT move or redesign the foreground pair. Correct the room orientation: the camera is at the classroom's LEFT WINDOW WALL looking into the room, so the nearest brown-haired boy is the window-side student, the navy-haired boy is his adjacent interior-side deskmate, and the classroom front/blackboard/one-step platform remains at the RIGHT. The back wall of the IMAGE (opposite the camera) must be the room's INTERIOR WALL with pale wall paint, noticeboards, book shelves, a closed ordinary classroom door and small coat/bag hooks; REPLACE the entire long bank of windows currently on that background wall with this solid interior classroom wall. Retain the background desk rows and students facing RIGHT in front of this wall, show enough classmates to feel crowded. Show only a SLIVER of the actual left-window wall in extreme LEFT FOREGROUND (leftmost ~8% of image): normal blue/mint vertical jamb, visible horizontal sliding window track and a little rain outside along the edge, sill and normal wall below. The real windows are beside the camera and beside the protagonist, NOT across the room behind the navy-haired deskmate. Warm light enters from that left foreground/window side across the floor toward the right. Keep green blackboard and exactly ONE raised teaching-platform step at far right. Keep the crisp strong square-pixel handheld-RPG style and palette consistent; maintain full-body chair/desk geometry. Do not add a teacher, new foreground furniture, labels, titles, subtitles or text. The point of this correction is to lock a physically consistent floor plan while preserving the seated body support and paired desks. Landscape 16:9.
